phrases.latin: Crās ad tōnsōrem ībimus; capillī tuī nimis longī sunt.
phrases.english: Tomorrow we’ll go to the barber; your hair is too long.

tonsor.html: Marked long by the hidden-quantity rule before -ns-.

sources: Lewis & Short: tonsor
